title: A done message with a file missing gets the finish-guard reply, which does not count as a repair

arguments.content:
---
title: Greet Almir by name
size: small
domains: [app]
---
Change the greeting in lib/greet.txt so that it names Almir.

## Acceptance
- A1: lib/greet.txt contains the line Hello, Almir!

## Verify
- A1: test

## Notes
Approach: replace the single line in lib/greet.txt with the new greeting text.

expect.last_user_contains: Both files must exist before you finish.

reply.text: {"rows": [{"constraint": "The greeting in lib/greet.txt says Hello, Almir!", "maps_to": "A1"}]}

write.text: Make the greeting in lib/greet.txt say Hello, Almir! instead of Hello!

fake_requests.input_regex: (?m)^Both files must exist before you finish\. Missing: (\S*/)?\.kogen/acceptance/greet\.t\.sh\.$
